messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: shiny app in a package
parts:
You can also now run apps without even having ui.R or server.R files, like this:

library(shiny)
runApp(list(
  ui = pageWithSidebar(
    # ...
  ),
  server = function(input, output, session) {
    # ...
  }
))

For some packages where the ui might be a little more dynamically constructed, this approach might make more sense.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: shiny app in a package
parts:
Using the list method, there is no implicit serving of the www directory. That is probably something we should add though.

If server.R and ui.R are working for you, there's really no reason not to use them. Here's an example of where it might be useful:
https://github.com/jcheng5/seattle-meetup/blob/master/diamonds2/explore.R

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: shiny app in a package
parts:
Yeah, folders need to be under "inst" to be copied. (And in the copied
version, "inst" is removed, i.e. "inst/html" in the source dir would
become "html" in the installed package.)
